text: The Open-Mesh MR600 is a cloud managed, dual band, 600 Mbps 802.11n mesh-capable access point that includes hardware watchdog, standard 802.3af POE support and a single Gigabit Ethernet port.
Special product: This product is only available while supplies last. It will be replaced with the MR900.
We recommend powering this unit with standard 802.3af PoE. It is also compatible with the 20v international power supply (add-on option).
The MR600 is available in a 2x2 600 (300+300) Mbps MIMO configuration
An included wall/ceiling mount, along with an optional outdoor enclosure, make for easy installations indoors and out.
Support for standard 802.3af PoE to power your access points up to 350 feet away over a single Ethernet cable.
